queries_run: Centrus Energy Russian uranium waiver ban TENEX 2026

findings.claim: 俄羅斯 TENEX 供貨受制裁、關稅、出口管制與俄方法令影響；加拿大運輸許可證延至 2027 年 3 月，進一步限制可能對業務造成重大負面影響。
findings.excerpt: A Canadian permit issued to our shipper was extended to March 2027, but for so long as the sanctions remain in place, the shipper will require further extensions beyond the current validity of the permit for continued shipments of LEU imports.

findings.claim: 美國於 2025-09-08 取消鈾進口關稅；國會另有對俄貨物課重稅草案；關稅可能增加設備成本，也可能提高美國產鈾需求。
findings.excerpt: On September 8, 2025, the U.S. officially removed import tariffs on uranium as part of a broader executive order aimed at strengthening domestic supply chains and supporting strategic industries. However, there is draft legislation in the U.S. Congress designed to impose potentially significant tariffs on Russian goods.

findings.claim: Section 232 關鍵礦物（含鈾）調查後，2026-01-14 公告 11001 要求 180 天談判，視結果可能再考慮加徵部門關稅。
findings.excerpt: Proclamation 11001 indicated that, depending on the status or outcome of those negotiations, alternative remedies may be considered in the future, including the imposition of an additional sectoral tariff.

findings.claim: 2026 年 10-Q 稱至 2027 年預計交付客戶的 LEU 逾半來自 TENEX 合約；未承諾量的豁免是否核准不確定（搜尋摘要，未讀頁面）。
findings.excerpt: through 2027, well over one-half of the LEU that we expect to deliver to customers was sourced under the TENEX Supply Contract

reg_tariff_export.note: 第 232 條 180 天談判窗約 2026 年 7 月中結束，搜尋未見結果；出口管制/實體清單與中國貿易限制未另搜。
